en.headline: Amber rainstorm and thunderstorm warnings in force this morning
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued an Amber Rainstorm Warning at 6.10am and a Thunderstorm Warning earlier, with heavy showers and risk of flooding in low-lying areas.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued an Amber Rainstorm Warning Signal at 6.10am on Sunday, indicating that heavy rain exceeding 30 millimetres in an hour had fallen or was expected to fall generally over Hong Kong and was likely to continue. A Thunderstorm Warning had been issued earlier at 5.05am and was later extended until 9.30am.

The Observatory said there would be flooding in some low-lying and poorly drained areas, and that heavy rain might bring flash floods. Members of the public were advised to take precautions, stay away from watercourses and listen to the latest traffic updates. Heavy showers this morning brought about 30 millimetres of rain to many places, with more than 50 millimetres recorded over Lantau Island.

The flag-raising ceremony scheduled for 8am at Golden Bauhinia Square in Wan Chai was cancelled because the Thunderstorm Warning was in force. The Observatory forecast cloudy conditions with showers and squally thunderstorms for the rest of Sunday, with rain heavy at times and a maximum temperature around 28 degrees Celsius.

zh.headline: 黃色暴雨及雷暴警告今早生效
zh.dek: 天文台於上午6時10分發出黃色暴雨警告信號，較早前已發出雷暴警告，本港有大雨及低窪地區可能水浸。
body: 香港天文台於星期日上午6時10分發出黃色暴雨警告信號，表示香港廣泛地區已有或預料有超過每小時30毫米的大雨，並可能持續。雷暴警告則於清晨5時05分發出，其後延長至上午9時30分。
天文台表示，部分低窪及排水較差的地區可能出現水浸，大雨亦可引發山洪。市民應提高警覺，遠離河道，並留意最新交通消息。今早大驟雨為多處帶來約30毫米雨量，大嶼山錄得超過50毫米。
因雷暴警告生效，原定上午8時於灣仔金紫荊廣場舉行的升旗儀式已取消。天文台預測今日大致多雲，有驟雨及狂風雷暴，雨勢有時頗大，最高氣溫約28度。
